cryptdisks_enable.description: Whether to run cryptdisks initscripts at startup.

cryptdisks_mount.description: Space-separated list of mountpoints to mount before cryptsetup is invoked at init scripts (e.g., for keyfiles on removable media). Default is unset (empty string).

cryptdisks_check.description: Default check script used when 'check' option is set in crypttab without a value.
